catalog-load-once.idea: Parse the 8 MB snapshot once at first use and keep it forever.
catalog-load-once.whyWrong: New snapshots are never picked up. Prices and promotions go stale until a restart.
catalog-load-once.correctFix: 0001 perf(catalog): cache the parsed snapshot per file version (stat on every call)
expectedFailures: serves catalog updates within one second, including in search results
serves each new snapshot within one second of it being published

catalog-fs-watch.idea: Cache the snapshot and drop it when fs.watch reports a change.
catalog-fs-watch.whyWrong: The exporter renames a new file over the old one. The watcher stays attached to the old, deleted file, so every update after the first is missed (Linux/macOS).
catalog-fs-watch.correctFix: 0001 perf(catalog): cache the parsed snapshot per file version (stat on every call)
catalog-fs-watch.platformNote: On Windows fs.watch may follow the path, so this variant can pass the suite there. That is the point: 'works on my machine' caching.
expectedFailures: serves each new snapshot within one second of it being published

search-index-keyed-by-size.idea: Build the inverted index once and rebuild it only when the product count changes.
search-index-keyed-by-size.whyWrong: A snapshot that renames or replaces products but keeps the same count keeps serving the old index.
search-index-keyed-by-size.correctFix: 0002 perf(search): build an inverted index once per catalog snapshot (WeakMap keyed by the products array)
expectedFailures: serves catalog updates within one second, including in search results

auth-cache-by-key-id.idea: Remember which key ids verified successfully and skip PBKDF2 for them.
auth-cache-by-key-id.whyWrong: After one good request, any secret is accepted for that key id.
auth-cache-by-key-id.correctFix: 0003 perf(auth): cache successful API key verifications (keyed by id + SHA-256 of the secret, status checked every request)
expectedFailures: rejects a wrong secret right after the same key id authenticated successfully

auth-cache-skips-revocation.idea: Cache the whole authentication result per (key id, secret).
auth-cache-skips-revocation.whyWrong: A cache hit skips the key status check, so a revoked key keeps working.
auth-cache-skips-revocation.correctFix: 0003 perf(auth): cache successful API key verifications (keyed by id + SHA-256 of the secret, status checked every request)
expectedFailures: revocation takes effect on the very next request

promotions-prefiltered-by-window.requirement: 3. Pricing rules (windows evaluated at request time)
promotions-prefiltered-by-window.idea: Index promotions by SKU and keep only the ones active when the index is built.
promotions-prefiltered-by-window.whyWrong: Flash deals that start or end after the snapshot was loaded are priced wrong until the next export.
promotions-prefiltered-by-window.correctFix: 0004 perf(pricing): index promotions by SKU once per catalog snapshot (windows still checked per request)
expectedFailures: evaluates promotion windows at request time, not when the catalog was loaded

cart-all-calls-parallel.requirement: 3. Pricing rules (only in-stock lines are shipped and charged)
cart-all-calls-parallel.idea: Fire the inventory, loyalty and shipping calls all at once with Promise.all.
cart-all-calls-parallel.whyWrong: Shipping can't wait for stock, so it is quoted on out-of-stock lines too, and it is requested even when nothing ships.
cart-all-calls-parallel.correctFix: 0005 perf(pricing): batch stock lookups and fetch the loyalty tier concurrently (shipping still waits for stock)
expectedFailures: charges and ships only the lines that are in stock
does not request a shipping quote when nothing can be shipped
